about: Common identities (design-interview Q61; work/in-place-refactor-design/common-sources.md): sources that almost every shader host provides (TD, ISF, Shadertoy…), as opposed to what only TD provides. Definitions point here with `common`; graphs never store it. Section 2 of the list (time, frame, frameStep, pixelSize, passIndex) is not decided yet. build:core generates src/core-ts/common_sources.ts.

sources.meaning: Seconds since the host started running; keeps going.
Seconds from the previous frame to this one.
Frames since the host started running.
Normalized coordinates of this pixel, 0 to 1.
Width and height of the output in pixels.
